project.title: Treatment of low-strength ammonia wastewater by single-stage partial nitritation and anammox using upflow dual-bed moving-bed reactor (UDMR)
project.description: This study investigated the treatment of dilute wastewater (<150 mg NH4+-N/L) by S-PNA using upflow dual-bed moving-bed reactors (UDMRs), inoculated with gel-entrapped biomass, in an attempt to explore the potential for its mainstream application.
project.center_name: Ulsan national institute of science and technology
